reviewed_by: Claude: Ask Nebula popup selection actions
reason: AskNebulaPopup wrapped its whole body in data-selection-actions-disabled, so SelectionActionsProvider dropped every selection inside the popup. The attribute now covers only the header and composer, and the body names its selections as an Ask Nebula conversation. AskNebulaPopup.test.tsx covers answer selection -> toolbar -> Ask draft and composer suppression; the native-scope-status Playwright test now selects popup context text and checks the toolbar is visible and in the viewport.
exclusions: Only the popup markup changed; SelectionActionsProvider, placement and WorkbenchDraftContext are unchanged (their suites passed locally, 64 tests, not selected). No Core, API or settings change, so no Python tests and no settings-assistant update.
